main.summary: Provides file-system staging operations for segmented transfer sessions.

method.name: GetSessionPaths
method.summary: Resolve conventional paths for a session.

method.name: CreateSession
method.summary: Create the staging artifacts for a new session.
method.returns: Resolved session paths when creation succeeds.

method.name: LoadManifest
method.summary: Load the persisted manifest for a session.

method.name: SaveManifest
method.summary: Persist the manifest for a session.

method.name: ReadObjectPayload
method.summary: Read the serialized object payload for a session.

method.name: WriteRange
method.summary: Write a payload range into the staged sparse stream file.
method.param: Readable payload stream positioned at the first byte to write.
method.returns: Detailed outcome of the attempted staged range write.

method.name: ReadRange
method.summary: Read a realized payload range from the staged sparse stream file.
method.returns: Readable stream covering the returned payload range.

method.name: DeleteSession
method.summary: Delete all staged artifacts for a session.
method.returns: True when the staged session is deleted or no longer exists.
